name: implicit_deadline
description: Original 4-task set: deadline == period for every task. Cannot demonstrate RM vs. DM choosing different priority orders (their fixed-priority order only depends on which of period/deadline you sort by, and here the two always agree) -- see constrained_deadline.json for that. Matches SCHED_TASKSET=0 in Code/schedPolicy.h and the vSchedulerPeriodicTaskCreate() calls in Code/main/main.ino.
